summary.en: Electric guitars learn to talk dirty—and teenagers get a soundtrack.
summary.zh: 电吉他学会说脏话——青少年第一次有了自己的配乐。

sound.en: Twang, backbeat, radio crackle, Saturday-night volume
sound.zh: 拨弦脆响、后拍、电台沙沙声、周六夜晚的音量

body.en:
Before rock had museums, it had jukeboxes. Blues players bent notes until they hurt; Chuck Berry turned the guitar into a joke you could dance to; Elvis made the whole country argue about hips.

This decade isn't a polite prologue. It's the spark: amplification + youth + radio. Everything later—British Invasion, metal, punk sneers—still borrows vocabulary invented in these rooms.
body.zh:
摇滚还没进博物馆的时候，它待在点唱机里。Blues 把音弯到疼；Chuck Berry 把吉他变成能跳舞的笑话；Elvis 让整个国家为了胯部吵起来。

这十年不是客气的序章。它是火星：扩音 + 青春 + 电台。后面所有东西——英伦入侵、金属、朋克的冷笑——仍在借用这些房间里发明的词汇。
